title: RawArchiveManifest
description: Public-safe JSON Schema for the private raw-archive manifest (Task 030 / 032). The manifest itself is stored in the private archive and is NEVER published, but its shape (this schema) is publishable so downstream tooling can validate it. The schema deliberately omits any archive filesystem path; callers resolve 'archive_id' to a real path via a separate private lookup. No endpoint host, deployment name, region, customer name, or secret pattern appears in this schema.

schema_version.description: Semver of the manifest schema (this file).

entries.description: One entry per Tier 1 (RAW_PRIVATE) file held in the private archive. Entries are deduplicated by 'archive_id' and SHOULD be sorted by 'archive_id' for deterministic on-disk bytes.

archive_id.description: Opaque pseudonym for the archived file. 'raw-' prefix followed by 16+ lowercase hex characters. Used as the cross-tier reference in public sidecar manifests; resolves to a real archive path ONLY via a private lookup not part of any public artifact.

sha256.description: Lowercase-hex SHA-256 digest of the archived file's bytes.

run_id.description: Opaque experiment-run identifier. Repo convention; not lifted from any vendor identifier.

experiment_yaml_sha256.description: Lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the experiment YAML used to produce this run.

captured_at_iso.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (with timezone) when the file was captured.

git_commit_sha.description: Git commit sha (7-40 lowercase hex) of the private working tree at capture time.

tier.description: Data-sensitivity tier. Always RAW_PRIVATE for entries in this manifest.
